Equity Rating and Dispersion Key
 The Equity Rating Dispersion Chart depicts the following:
 
 The proportion of recommendations that are rated "buy", "sell" and "hold" over the previous 12 months. This is shown for

the past 12 months  have a “buy” rating.
 
 Next to each of the three respective bars showing the proportion of "buy", "sell" and "hold" recommendations we provide
